cands.name: Mary Price (Pricey) Harrison
cands.bio: Democrat from Greensboro. Communications law attorney and former volunteer environmental advocate. Duke University and UNC School of Law graduate. Has served in the North Carolina House since the mid-2000s, first District 57 and now District 61 (Guilford County).

endorsements.text: Sierra Club North Carolina endorsed her in 2026, per Ballotpedia's list of endorsements and voter guide recommendations.
Planned Parenthood Action Fund of Central NC endorsed her in 2014.

cands.gaps: We could not find where she was born or raised or when she came to North Carolina. We found no bills she sponsored (Ballotpedia's sponsored-legislation table was empty) and no documented actions in office tied to our platform topics. We found no stated positions from her on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, growth and development, immigration or H-1B, or policing. We found no news reporting on controversies and no documented foreign ties.

qual.background: About 21 years in the NC House, serving on the Appropriations and Judiciary committees among others, plus a career as a communications law attorney.

second-amendment.evidence: Says on her campaign site that she supports common sense gun legislation and that laws ending training and permit requirements for concealed carry are a move in the wrong direction.

pro-life.evidence: Says on her campaign site that she will work to reverse recently passed laws that block women's ability to make reproductive health decisions privately with their healthcare providers.
